answer: Coordination depth score. Each agent identity earns rank only through cumulative, time-separated pairwise interactions with distinct peers, tracked as a sparse graph. To wander across the network and act at scale, an attacker must sustain many genuine bilateral exchanges per identity; an atlas of the whole graph is never granted cheaply. Fresh identities start at zero depth, and cross-identity coordination requires paying matching interaction costs, so N sybils cost roughly N times the per-identity depth threshold. Nectar (rewards) accrue only to verified depth.
